sources.source: Planning Data asset of community value dataset
sources.authority: MHCLG Planning Data / participating local authorities
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 101 assets from one provider; the collector last ran on 2026-07-21 and new data was last found on 2026-03-06.
sources.quality_effect: An ACV listing is a local land charge and may be a material consideration, but it does not itself prohibit development; the MHCLG-created origin and listing status require current local-authority readback.

sources.authority: Office for National Statistics / MHCLG Planning Data
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 7,157 built-up areas; the collector last ran on 2026-07-21 and new data was last found on 2024-06-11.
sources.quality_effect: Built-up-area geometry is a statistical settlement context, not a planning allocation or exact development boundary; mixed-origin limits are retained.

sources.source: Planning Data central activities zone dataset
sources.authority: Greater London Authority / London boroughs / MHCLG Planning Data
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 10 Central Activities Zone records from three providers; the collector last ran on 2026-07-18 and new data was last found on 2026-06-09.
sources.quality_effect: The CAZ is an area-level London policy context assembled from GLA and borough data; mixed-origin boundaries must not be converted directly into a parcel growth score.

sources.source: Planning Data flood storage area dataset
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 510 flood storage areas from one provider; the collector last ran on 2026-05-19 and new data was last found on 2025-08-08.
sources.quality_effect: The service states the data was created by MHCLG and will be replaced by authoritative-source data, so it is suitable only for preliminary constraint screening.

sources.source: Planning Data nature improvement area dataset
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 12 nature improvement areas; the collector last ran on 2025-10-19 and new data was last found on 2024-07-30.
sources.quality_effect: Nature Improvement Areas are strategic ecological areas with ad-hoc update characteristics; they can provide area context but not an exact parcel constraint or growth score.

sources.source: Planning Data agricultural land classification dataset
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 585 agricultural land classifications; the collector last ran on 2026-07-22 and new data was last found on 2024-07-15.
sources.quality_effect: Agricultural grade can inform land-quality screening, but the MHCLG-created origin and older source date block sole-source parcel scoring.

sources.source: Planning Data air quality management area dataset
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 498 air quality management areas; the collector last ran on 2026-07-21, new data was last found on 2026-04-15, and the origin is fully authoritative.
sources.quality_effect: AQMA intersection is an authoritative environmental planning consideration, but exact geometry relation and current designation status remain required before parcel scoring.

sources.source: Planning Data certificate of immunity dataset
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 251 certificates of immunity; the collector last ran on 2026-06-25 and new data was last found on 2026-06-19.
sources.quality_effect: A certificate is a time-bounded legal heritage-status record; mixed-origin data and Historic England's current GIS record must be checked before using it in parcel assessment.
